name: Person Type 2
definition: Specifies the type of customer identification requested for a person.

DateAndPlaceOfBirth.name: Date And Place Of Birth
DateAndPlaceOfBirth.definition: Date and place of birth of a person is requested.||Usage: When absent (default value), the identification is not requested.

EmailAddress.name: Email Address
EmailAddress.definition: Address for electronic mail (e-mail) is requested.||Usage: When absent (default value), the identification is not requested.

Other.name: Other
Other.definition: Unique identification of a person, as assigned by an institution, using an identification scheme is requested.
